summary.text: Jonathan Gleason is a Republican candidate for the Vermont State Senate, Windsor District (three seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary.
He ran for the same seat in 2024 and lost in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Gleason first appeared on the Windsor District ballot in 2024, when he advanced from the August 13 Republican primary with 23.0 percent of the vote.
In the November 5, 2024 general election for three seats he received 12.0 percent of the vote and did not win.
